issues.title: Floating toolbar overlaps card boundary
issues.description: Toolbar elements overlay card borders and sit too close to the bottom screen edge.
issues.evidence: Share and Alert actions overlap the card boundary while the Clear button sits directly beneath near the edge.
issues.suggestion: Anchor toolbar with proper safe-area padding away from card borders.
issues.triageNote: The straddle placement itself is deliberate page composition, but the flagged evidence (Clear orphaned on a second row, capsule grown to 86px tall and hanging near the screen edge) is a real component defect: with the common left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 centering, shrink-to-fit caps the toolbar at half the card width (~178px of 358px), so the inner flex-wrap breaks into ragged rows on narrow surfaces. Fixed by making the root w-max (existing max-w-full clamps to the surface): the capsule now keeps its single-row natural width (254px, measured) and only wraps when the surface itself is narrower than the content.
